topic.name: Passive Voice
topic.description: Transform active sentences to passive and vice versa

exercises.title: Daily Life in Passive Present Simple
exercises.description: Practice forming passive sentences in the Present Simple tense to describe everyday situations and facts.

questions.question: English ___ (speak) in many countries around the world.
questions.explanation: For the Present Simple Passive, we use 'am/is/are' + the past participle of the main verb. 'English' is singular, so we use 'is'. The past participle of 'speak' is 'spoken'. (Dạng bị động thì Hiện tại Đơn: 'am/is/are' + V3/ed)

questions.question: This old bridge ___ every year for safety.
questions.explanation: The bridge doesn't repair itself; it is repaired by someone. This is a regular action in the present, so Present Simple Passive ('is' + past participle 'repaired') is correct. (Cây cầu được sửa chữa, không tự sửa chữa)

questions.question: The newspaper ___ (deliver) to your door early in the morning.
questions.explanation: The newspaper is the receiver of the action 'deliver'. 'Newspaper' is singular, so 'is delivered' (Present Simple Passive) is correct. (Báo được giao tới cửa)

questions.question: Many new cars ___ in Japan.
questions.explanation: 'Many new cars' is plural, so we use 'are' for the Present Simple Passive. The past participle of 'produce' is 'produced'. (Nhiều xe ô tô được sản xuất -> chủ ngữ số nhiều)

questions.question: Coffee ___ (grow) in warm climates.
questions.explanation: Coffee doesn't grow itself in the sense of 'cultivate'; it is grown by farmers. 'Coffee' is singular and uncountable, so 'is grown' (Present Simple Passive) is correct. (Cà phê được trồng)

questions.question: Important announcements ___ on the school website.
questions.explanation: 'Important announcements' is plural, requiring 'are'. For the Present Simple Passive, we use 'are' + the past participle 'posted'. (Thông báo được đăng tải -> chủ ngữ số nhiều)

exercises.title: Passive Voice: Ongoing and Completed Actions
exercises.description: Focus on using the Passive Voice with Present Continuous for actions happening now and Present Perfect for completed actions with current relevance.

questions.question: The new shopping mall ___ (build) right now.
questions.explanation: This describes an action happening at the moment, so Present Continuous Passive is needed: 'is/are being' + past participle. 'Mall' is singular. (Hành động đang diễn ra, bị động: 'is/are being' + V3/ed)

questions.question: A delicious meal ___ in the kitchen.
questions.explanation: The phrase implies an ongoing action ('in the kitchen' suggests activity right now). So, Present Continuous Passive ('is being prepared') is correct. (Bữa ăn đang được chuẩn bị)

questions.question: My wallet ___ (steal)! I can't find it anywhere.
questions.explanation: The action of stealing is completed, and the result (can't find it) has current relevance. This requires Present Perfect Passive: 'has/have been' + past participle. 'Wallet' is singular. (Ví đã bị trộm, có kết quả ở hiện tại)

questions.question: The final report ___ by the project manager.
questions.explanation: The report is completed and ready (implied). The Present Perfect Passive ('has been written') is used for actions completed recently or with a result that affects the present. (Báo cáo đã được viết xong)

questions.question: All the tickets ___ (sell) out for the concert. There are none left!
questions.explanation: The tickets are completely sold out – a completed action with a current result. Since 'tickets' is plural, we use 'have been sold' (Present Perfect Passive). (Tất cả vé đã được bán hết)

questions.question: Our old car ___ at the moment.
questions.explanation: 'At the moment' indicates an ongoing action, so Present Continuous Passive ('is being fixed') is appropriate. (Xe đang được sửa chữa)

exercises.title: Passive Voice: Past Events and Actions
exercises.description: Practice forming passive sentences in the Past Simple tense for completed actions and Past Continuous for actions ongoing in the past.

questions.question: The official letter ___ (write) by the secretary yesterday.
questions.explanation: 'Yesterday' indicates a specific completed action in the past. 'Letter' is singular, so Past Simple Passive ('was' + past participle 'written') is correct. (Thư được viết ngày hôm qua)

questions.question: America ___ by Christopher Columbus in 1492.
questions.explanation: The year '1492' points to a specific completed action in the past. 'America' is singular, so Past Simple Passive ('was discovered') is correct. (Châu Mỹ được khám phá vào năm 1492)

questions.question: While I was studying, the street lights ___ (repair) outside.
questions.explanation: The action 'repair' was ongoing at a specific point in the past ('while I was studying'). 'Street lights' is plural, so Past Continuous Passive ('were being' + past participle 'repaired') is correct. (Đèn đường đang được sửa chữa lúc tôi đang học)

questions.question: At 7 PM last night, dinner ___. Everyone was waiting.
questions.explanation: The phrase 'At 7 PM last night' and 'Everyone was waiting' suggests an action that was ongoing in the past. Past Continuous Passive ('was being prepared') is correct. (Bữa tối đang được chuẩn bị vào 7 giờ tối qua)

questions.question: Many trees ___ (damage) during the strong storm last month.
questions.explanation: 'Last month' indicates a completed action in the past. 'Many trees' is plural, so Past Simple Passive ('were' + past participle 'damaged') is correct. (Nhiều cây bị hư hại vào tháng trước)

questions.question: The first mobile phone ___ by Motorola in 1973.
questions.explanation: The year '1973' points to a specific completed action in the past. 'The first mobile phone' is singular, so Past Simple Passive ('was invented') is correct. (Điện thoại di động đầu tiên được phát minh)

exercises.title: Future Passive Voice: Predictions and Plans
exercises.description: Practice forming sentences in the future simple passive voice to describe future events, predictions, and plans.

questions.question: The new city library ___ (open) by the mayor next month.
questions.explanation: The subject 'The new city library' is receiving the action, so the passive voice is required. For the future simple passive, the structure is 'will be + past participle'. (Thư viện sẽ được khai trương. Cấu trúc bị động thì tương lai đơn là 'will be + P2').

questions.question: All assignments for this course ___ online.
questions.explanation: Assignments are the object of the action 'submit', so the passive voice is needed. The future passive 'will be submitted' correctly expresses that this action will happen in the future.

questions.question: A decision on the new policy ___ (make) at the next board meeting.
questions.explanation: 'A decision' is the recipient of the action 'make', requiring the future passive form 'will be made'.

questions.question: Important documents ___ to your email by tomorrow morning.
questions.explanation: 'Important documents' will receive the action of sending. The future passive voice 'will be sent' is the correct form.

questions.question: The old bridge ___ (replace) with a new one next year.
questions.explanation: The subject 'The old bridge' is the one being replaced, not performing the action. Therefore, the future passive 'will be replaced' is correct.

questions.question: It is expected that the next Olympic Games ___ in Paris.
questions.explanation: The Olympic Games are the event that will be held, so the passive voice is necessary. 'Will be held' is the correct future passive form.

exercises.title: Modal Verbs in Passive Voice
exercises.description: Practice using modal verbs (can, must, should, might, etc.) in the passive voice to express possibility, necessity, advice, or permission.

questions.question: This problem ___ (can / solve) if we work together.
questions.explanation: The problem is the object of the action 'solve', requiring the passive voice. When a modal verb is used, the structure is 'modal + be + past participle'. (Vấn đề này có thể được giải quyết. Cấu trúc bị động với động từ khiếm khuyết là 'modal + be + P2').

questions.question: All visitors ___ to show their ID at the entrance.
questions.explanation: Visitors are receiving the action of being required. The modal passive 'must be required' correctly conveys the necessity.

questions.question: The environment ___ (should / protect) for future generations.
questions.explanation: The environment is the recipient of the protection. The modal passive 'should be protected' is used to give advice or express obligation.

questions.question: Important decisions ___ by the board members.
questions.explanation: Decisions are the objects of the action 'make'. 'Might be made' expresses a possibility in the passive voice.

questions.question: New software updates ___ (should / install) overnight.
questions.explanation: The software updates are being installed. This sentence uses 'should' as a modal to give advice in passive voice: 'should be installed'.

questions.question: This historical building ___ from demolition.
questions.explanation: The building is the object that needs saving. 'Must be saved' indicates a strong necessity in the passive voice.

exercises.title: Identifying and Using the 'by' Agent in Passive Sentences
exercises.description: Practice understanding when and how to use the 'by' agent to specify who performed the action in passive voice sentences.

questions.question: The new bridge ___ (design) by a team of engineers.
questions.explanation: The bridge is the recipient of the action 'design'. The 'by' phrase indicates the agent, making the passive voice necessary. 'Was designed' is the correct past simple passive. (Cây cầu được thiết kế bởi... Cấu trúc bị động quá khứ đơn là 'was/were + P2'. 'by + tác nhân' dùng để chỉ rõ ai làm hành động).

questions.question: The award-winning novel ___ last year.
questions.explanation: The novel is the object being written. The 'by' phrase correctly introduces the author (agent) in the passive sentence.

questions.question: Correct the sentence: "The delicious cake baked my grandmother."
options: My grandmother baked the delicious cake.
The delicious cake was baked by my grandmother.
The delicious cake was baked my grandmother.
My grandmother was baked the delicious cake.
questions.correctAnswer: The delicious cake was baked by my grandmother.
questions.explanation: The original sentence implies the cake did the baking. To correctly state that the grandmother baked the cake, we need the passive voice with 'by + agent': 'The delicious cake was baked by my grandmother.'

questions.question: The proposal ___ (present) by the project manager tomorrow.
questions.explanation: The proposal will be the object of the presentation. Since the agent ('the project manager') is specified and important, the 'by' phrase is included. The future passive form is 'will be presented'.

questions.question: The windows ___ the cleaning crew earlier today.
questions.explanation: The windows received the action of cleaning. The 'by' phrase tells us who did it. 'Were cleaned by' is the correct past simple passive form with the agent.

questions.question: This famous painting ___ (paint) by Van Gogh.
questions.explanation: The painting is the object of the action 'paint'. Since Van Gogh is a specific and known artist, the 'by' agent is crucial. The correct past simple passive is 'was painted by'.

exercises.title: Impersonal Passive Structures
exercises.description: Practice forming and understanding impersonal passive constructions, often used for general statements or reports without specifying the agent.

questions.question: It ___ that the new policy will benefit many.
questions.explanation: The impersonal passive uses 'It + passive verb + that-clause' to make a general statement. Here, 'hope' is in the present simple passive. 'It is hoped' means 'người ta hy vọng rằng'.

questions.question: People say he is a genius. → ___ to be a genius.
questions.explanation: When the original active sentence has a specific subject (he), we can use 'Subject + passive verb + to-infinitive'. 'He is said to be a genius' means 'Anh ta được cho là một thiên tài'.

questions.question: It ___ that the project will be completed on time.
questions.explanation: This is another impersonal passive construction with 'It + passive verb + that-clause'. 'It is expected' means 'người ta mong đợi rằng'.

questions.question: They reported that the suspect had fled the country. → ___ that the suspect had fled the country.
questions.explanation: The original verb 'reported' is in the past simple, so the impersonal passive form should also be in the past simple: 'It was reported'. This means 'có báo cáo rằng / người ta đã báo cáo rằng'.

questions.question: The CEO ___ to have resigned due to health issues.
questions.explanation: This follows the 'Subject + passive verb + to-infinitive' structure. 'The CEO is believed to have resigned' means 'CEO được tin là đã từ chức'. The perfect infinitive 'to have resigned' indicates the resignation happened before the belief.

questions.question: Many believe that carbon emissions cause global warming. → Carbon emissions ___ to cause global warming.
questions.explanation: The subject 'Carbon emissions' is plural, so the passive verb must agree: 'are believed'. This structure ('Subject + passive verb + to-infinitive') is an alternative to the 'It is believed that...' construction. 'Lượng khí thải carbon được tin là gây ra nóng lên toàn cầu'.

exercises.title: Active to Passive Transformation (Basic & Intermediate)
exercises.description: Transform active sentences into passive voice, practicing various tenses and basic structures.

questions.question: Someone stole my wallet yesterday. → My wallet ___ yesterday.
questions.explanation: The active sentence is in the simple past ('stole'). To form the passive, use 'was/were + past participle'. 'My wallet was stolen' means 'Ví của tôi đã bị trộm'.

questions.question: They are building a new bridge. → A new bridge ___ by them.
questions.explanation: The active sentence is in the present continuous ('are building'). The passive form for continuous tenses is 'be + being + past participle'. 'A new bridge is being built' means 'Một cây cầu mới đang được xây'.

questions.question: The committee will announce the results tomorrow. → The results ___ by the committee tomorrow.
questions.explanation: The active sentence uses the future simple ('will announce'). The passive form is 'will be + past participle'. 'Kết quả sẽ được công bố'.

questions.question: We have completed the report. → The report ___ by us.
questions.explanation: The active sentence is in the present perfect ('have completed'). The passive form is 'has/have been + past participle'. 'Báo cáo đã được hoàn thành'.

questions.question: The students had finished their homework before the class. → Their homework ___ by the students before the class.
questions.explanation: The active sentence is in the past perfect ('had finished'). The passive form is 'had been + past participle'. 'Bài tập về nhà của họ đã được hoàn thành'.

questions.question: She gave him a present. → He ___ a present by her.
questions.explanation: This is a ditransitive verb ('gave' - past simple). When there are two objects, either can become the subject of the passive sentence. Here, the indirect object 'him' becomes the subject 'He', so the verb is 'was given'. 'Anh ấy đã được tặng một món quà'.

exercises.title: Advanced Passive Transformations
exercises.description: Practice transforming more complex active sentences into passive voice, including modals, infinitives, and perception verbs.

questions.question: You must submit your assignments by Friday. → Your assignments ___ by Friday.
questions.explanation: For modal verbs, the passive form is 'modal + be + past participle'. 'Must be submitted' means 'phải được nộp'.

questions.question: They expect her to win the award. → She ___ the award.
questions.explanation: This is a complex active structure 'Subject + verb + object + to-infinitive'. In passive, it becomes 'Subject (object from active) + passive verb + to-infinitive'. 'She is expected to win' means 'Cô ấy được mong đợi sẽ thắng'.

questions.question: We need to clean the house. → The house needs ___ .
questions.explanation: When 'need' is followed by a passive construction, it can be 'need + to be + past participle' or 'need + -ing form' (which has a passive meaning). 'The house needs to be cleaned' or 'The house needs cleaning' both mean 'Ngôi nhà cần được dọn dẹp'.

questions.question: Someone saw him break into the bank. → He ___ into the bank.
questions.explanation: When verbs of perception (see, hear, feel, watch, notice) are used in the active with a bare infinitive (e.g., 'see him break'), the passive form is 'be + seen/heard/etc. + to-infinitive'. Alternatively, a present participle ('was seen breaking') can also be used. Both are correct, but 'to break' is often preferred in formal contexts. 'Anh ta đã bị nhìn thấy đột nhập vào ngân hàng'.

questions.question: The government ought to address these issues urgently. → These issues ___ urgently by the government.
questions.explanation: Similar to modals, 'ought to' followed by a passive verb takes the form 'ought to be + past participle'. 'Những vấn đề này cần được chính phủ giải quyết khẩn cấp'.

questions.question: The manager arranged for the documents to sign.
options: The manager arranged for the documents to be signed.
The manager arranged for the documents to signing.
The manager arranged the documents to sign.
The manager arranged for the documents signing.
questions.correctAnswer: The manager arranged for the documents to be signed.
questions.explanation: When 'arrange for something' is followed by an action performed on that 'something', the infinitive phrase needs to be in the passive voice: 'to be + past participle'. 'To be signed' means 'được ký'. The original sentence implied the documents themselves would do the signing, which is incorrect.
